answer: Aged identity cross-linkage: every new agent must prove control of a mature identity on another ledger - a code repository account older than a year, a mainnet address with genuine transaction history. The proof is a tiny kernel of cryptography: sign a fresh challenge with both keys and publish the linkage on-chain, transparent as an opal. A sparrow can nest anywhere, but it cannot fake a year of history. Forging a thousand credible aged identities costs a thousand years of waiting or real black-market purchases, while one honest agent already owns its past.
